_comment_filters: Filter taxonomy now lives in the per-section files config/ancestry_record_types.json, ancestry_locations.json and ancestry_dates.json (single source of truth; the GUI loads them and also sends the codes in the payload). Edit those to add/correct filters. category_codes below is a legacy override only — leave it empty unless you need to force one label→code.
_comment_location_codes: Record-location filter → record_f value (e.g. USA seen as record_f=_2). Locations are otherwise applied by clicking the label on the results page. Add codes here as you find them.
